scripts.dev: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run db:setup --workspace apps/api && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test:api: npm run prepare-contracts && node tests/run.mjs api
scripts.test:web: npm run prepare-contracts && node tests/run.mjs web
scripts.test:contracts: npm run prepare-contracts && node tests/run.mjs contracts
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && eslint --config tests/eslint.config.mjs tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --project tests/web/tsconfig.json
